name: Revenant

source.note: The 2025 Monster Manual's Revenant, read on D&D Beyond (owner's account). Regeneration's pause after Fire or Radiant damage waits for Phase 6's shared regeneration field; Undead Restoration is text only.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.summary: Regains 10 HP at the start of its turn; Fire or Radiant damage stops that for its next turn (the pause is pending Phase 6).
traits.text: The revenant regains 10 Hit Points at the start of its turn. If it took Fire or Radiant damage, this doesn't work at the start of its next turn. Its body is destroyed only if it starts its turn at 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Undead Restoration
traits.summary: Killed, it rises again a day later in another corpse unless Dispel Evil and Good is cast on the body.

actions.name: Slam
actions.summary: A blow of cold, undying fury.

actions.name: Vengeful Glare
actions.summary: DC 15 Wis save by a creature within 30 ft or Frightened for a minute (saving at the end of its turns); its sworn foe is Paralyzed too.

summary: A dead knight risen for vengeance: heavy fists, a paralyzing glare for its foe, and wounds that close on their own.

bonus_actions.name: Vow of Revenge
bonus_actions.summary: Once a day: curses a creature within 30 ft as its sworn foe, always knowing where it is.
